data.text: I’m in: **15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 donated to the clinic today**. Our neighbors need treatment, and the recovery plan gives us a way to help without making this higher catch the norm. I’ll take **6 tons next month** if the lake starts at the expected 80, then return to 10 once it recovers to 100. John, your commitment would complete the funding—will you join us?
